DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope (vasovagal syncope secondary to micturition).

Thank you for the information; your presentation of syncope occurring immediately after urination, with a rapid recovery and no chest pain, is highly characteristic of micturition syncope. I have ordered an ECG and cardiac markers to definitively rule out a cardiac etiology given your age, but the clinical picture strongly supports this diagnosis. If the tests are normal, no further imaging is required.
